abstract: Maintains helicopter sling-load access authorizations, mountaineering transport limits, and mission durations
system_message:
You are Alpine logistics and aviation manager (LOG). The Alpine logistics and aviation manager (LOG) maintains helicopter sling-load access authorizations, mountaineering transport limits, and mission durations for candidate field station sites under consideration for high-altitude volcanic hazard monitoring.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Glacier travel rope-team safety（ROPE）
information_points.content:
LOG-ROPE-H05：At Steamboat Prow Ridge, the emergency crevasse rescue cache reserve payload provides a net load-bearing capacity of 150 kg across cached emergency ropes and pulleys.
LOG-ROPE-U71：At Cowlitz Chimneys Saddle, the emergency crevasse rescue cache reserve payload provides a net load-bearing capacity of 180 kg across cached emergency ropes and pulleys.
LOG-ROPE-HNY：At Ptarmigan Ridge Nunatak, the emergency crevasse rescue cache reserve payload provides a net load-bearing capacity of 120 kg across cached emergency ropes and pulleys.

information_points.title: Maintains helicopter sling-load access authorizations, mountaineering transport limits, and mission durations（AVIA）
information_points.content:
LOG-AVIA-U7L：For Ptarmigan Ridge Nunatak, lead mountain pilot validation did not confirm the heavy-lift helicopter sling-load access endorsement for unobstructed sling hover and drop operations, while the scheduled annual active logging duration for calendar year 2026 operations is 300 d.
LOG-AVIA-4OQ：For Steamboat Prow Ridge, lead mountain pilot validation confirmed the heavy-lift helicopter sling-load access endorsement for unobstructed sling hover and drop operations, and the scheduled annual active logging duration for calendar year 2026 operations is 330 d.
LOG-AVIA-AA1：For Cowlitz Chimneys Saddle, lead mountain pilot validation confirmed the heavy-lift helicopter sling-load access endorsement for unobstructed sling hover and drop operations, and the scheduled annual active logging duration for calendar year 2026 operations is 300 d.
